summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-Y3 admits no external crate. academic-readiness links academic-competency, academic-domain, academic-knowledge-state, academic-role-profile, serde and thiserror as product edges, and academic-audit, academic-competency, academic-export, academic-ingestion, academic-model-run, academic-policy, academic-record, academic-repository, academic-repository-analysis, academic-repository-classification, academic-repository-competency, academic-repository-correlation, academic-requirement, academic-role-profile, academic-untrusted-content, serde_json, trybuild and uuid as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package. Nothing links into a product binary that was not already there: the four workspace product edges are path packages this repository already builds, and serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt. Build-time-only additions are zero -- there is no build script, no proc macro beyond serde's and thiserror's, and no code generator.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-readiness is the P2-Y3 boundary: section 24.3's competency x evidence matrix as the default view, its six separated columns, the auxiliary score that does not exist without its four disclosures, section 24.4's four navigation directions and their two termini, and the non-guarantee notice that travels inside the document. It owns the axis vocabulary, which is the design document's own table header measured in two independent places; the cell, which separates missing from unknown and holds neither in the same type as a freshness band; the score, whose one producer computes the number from the disclosed weights and takes no number at all; the walk, whose result holds its first terminus by value so an empty walk is not a value; and the notice, which has one producer and no argument. It is a separate package from academic-role-profile because that crate owns which performances a role asks for and this one owns what the evidence says about them, and the direction of the edge is what keeps a bundle declarable without a matrix and a matrix impossible without a bundle at an exact version.

no_second_vocabulary_note: Section 13.3's six freshness bands were implemented by P2-N3 over academic_domain::FreshnessBand, and this task adds neither again: FreshnessCell wraps that enumeration and this crate declares no band of its own, has no decay function and takes no time input, so the sixth column carries P2-N3's answer rather than a second one. Section 24.3's six evidence stages were implemented by P2-Y1 as EvidenceStage, and this crate's six ReadinessAxis columns are a DIFFERENT six read out of a different place in the same subsection: the table header row and section 36.9's per-competency block, which agree with each other position by position and disagree with the prose's stage names on three of six. The two sets overlap on exactly one spelling, 설계 선택, and an_axis_and_a_stage_are_two_vocabularies requires them to remain unequal and to keep exactly that overlap, so the reading recorded in docs/contracts/career-readiness-matrix.md fails here if the document stops supporting it. No function maps a stage or a section 13.2 evidence kind to a column, and no_function_maps_a_stage_or_a_kind_to_an_axis compares the whole set of public signatures for one: P2-Y1 recorded that a total map between section 13.2's eight rows and section 24.3's six stages would have to invent three of its six answers, and one layer up the same map would have to invent the 설계 선택 column's, because that column has no section 13.2 row at all. Section 7.1's node hierarchy is read rather than restated: RowSubject::node_type returns NodeType::Competency from academic-domain. Section 13.1's UNSEEN_MEANING is P2-N2's sentence, and this crate paraphrases none of it.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-competency: Competency, CompetencyId, CriterionId, ConceptRef, EvidenceStage, EvidenceSource, StageEvidence and PerformanceCriterion. A matrix row names a competency by the identity P2-Y1 issues; a walk ends at one of that crate's own performance criteria; a placement carries the record's stage read off the record rather than asserted beside it; and a cell is settled only when the competency's own rubric admits a row at that criterion and that stage, which is that crate's judgement and not a second one here.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: FreshnessBand, which is section 13.3's six bands, and predicates::NodeType for RowSubject. The band is the sixth column's whole content: this crate has no decay, no clock and no time argument anywhere, so P2-N3 keeps freshness and this crate only displays it -- beside missing and unknown and never folded into either.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-knowledge-state: EvidenceKind, named in the module documentation and in the scan that refuses a map from it to a column. Section 13.1's UNSEEN_MEANING is that crate's own sentence, and section 24.3's dependency refusal is section 13.2's own ceiling read through P2-Y1's PromotingEvidence rather than a rule written here.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-role-profile: RoleProfile, RoleProfileRef and BundleImportance. A matrix is taken of one bundle at one version and records it by the lineage-and-version pair, which is P2-Y2's identity and not section 24.2's folded backend_engineer_profile_v4 spelling: P2-R4 measured a concatenated-and-truncated key colliding two findings whose goal version alone differed, and a matrix keyed on a rendered name would be that shape one stage up. The row set is the bundle's own entry order, and the importance beside each row is carried and never scored.

dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-audit: P2-U3's GraduationAuditEngine, DegreeAudit, select and encode, so the bundle non_guarantee_disclaimer_survives_export writes records a real graduation audit that a vendor-free restore re-runs. Reached through that crate's own fixture module by #[path], the way academic-export's suite reaches it.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-competency: Declared a second time for the trybuild reason academic-scenario gives: a compile-fail case compiles against this crate plus its dev-dependencies, and three of the ten cases name a competency, a criterion or a stage.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-export: P2-P1's write_bundle and read_bundle. The whole content of non_guarantee_disclaimer_survives_export is that somebody holding only a graduation bundle -- no product, no key, no vendor, no school account -- cannot read the matrix without the notice, and that is measured against that crate's own writer and reader rather than a simulation of them. It stays a dev edge on purpose: a readiness view whose product closure held the exporter could carry a notice the exporter minted, and the point is that the notice is in the document.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-ingestion: What P2-U3's fixture module needs to publish a rule set, and Date, which P2-Y2's RecordedOn wraps for a bundle's validAt.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-model-run: CalibrationRegistry and its dataset types, to build the fresh calibration P2-R2's OBSERVED rungs require before a finding exists to classify and promote from.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-policy: ContentDigest, for the analysis policy hash a P2-R1 snapshot request carries.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-record: What P2-U3's fixture module needs for its transcript, attempt history and classification rule set.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository: P2-R1's capture_local, SnapshotRequest and the identity types a request carries, so the corpus behind the one personal application claim is a frozen snapshot that passed the permission and secret gate rather than a fabricated one.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-analysis: P2-R2's EvidenceLadder, Locator, PathClass and analyze, so the corpus's OBSERVED rung is that crate's own judgement.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-classification: P2-R4's classify and the proof-chain types, so the stances the promotion reads are produced rather than written.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-competency: P2-R5's promote and PersonalApplicationClaim, which is what a FROM_PROJECT walk starts from: the claim identifier is the starting point, and a walk that matched on anything weaker would be the folded key P2-R4 measured.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-correlation: P2-R3's correlate, which the classification takes as its input.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-requirement: P2-U2's RuleSet, which the recorded graduation audit is evaluated against.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-role-profile: Declared a second time for the same trybuild reason, and used by the fixture to declare every bundle through that crate's own declare rather than fabricating one.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-untrusted-content: SourceIndex, which P2-R1's capture_local returns and P2-R2's AnalysisInput::of checks every unit against.
dev_workspace_dependencies.serde_json: The export round trip and the history comparison. The readiness view is serialized, carried as a claim's canonical JSON through a real P2-P1 bundle, read back byte for byte, and then offered to published_notice with the notice removed and with the notice altered.
dev_workspace_dependencies.trybuild: The compile-fail suite. Section 24.3's and 24.4's separations are types, and the ten cases under crates/readiness/tests/compile_fail assert that each refusal is a program that does not compile with a committed diagnostic -- an empty filled cell, a score assembled field by field, a score published without its weighting, a score read back out of a document, a view read back out of a document, a notice somebody wrote, a band handed to the cell constructor, a stage handed to the column argument, a termination with no first terminus, and a setter on a matrix row.
dev_workspace_dependencies.uuid: Deterministic UUIDv7-shaped fixture identities, derived from a digest of the fixture's name rather than from a clock. The same helper P2-N2's and P2-Y1's suites use.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-readiness is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns section 24.3 and section 24.4, whose whole content is that a person is not summarised by one number. Seven separations hold that rather than a sentence. The matrix is the default view because it is the only one: ReadinessView::of takes no mode, no preference and no flag, render emits ViewBlock::Matrix first in every view the crate can produce, and the whole set of public functions producing a ViewBlock is compared against render. No aggregate percentage is the primary output, and that absence is stated as three whole-set comparisons rather than as a list of forbidden names -- block zero is the matrix positionally, the block vocabulary is closed in both directions, and no f32 or f64 is declared anywhere in the crate, so a ratio has no type to arrive in whatever it is called. A score does not exist without its four disclosures: disclose is the one producer, it takes all four by value, it has no score parameter at all -- the number is computed from the disclosed weights over the disclosed matrix -- and it re-derives the rubric, the sources and the missing data from that matrix and refuses any disclosure that disagrees, so a disclosure taken of a different matrix is refused rather than published beside a number it does not describe. Missing, unknown and freshness are three types with no conversion between the cell and the band in either direction, which matters precisely because academic_domain::FreshnessBand has its own Unknown spelled the same as AxisCell::Unknown and meaning something else. Every one of section 24.4's four directions terminates: traverse returns a Termination whose one constructor takes its first terminus by value, so an empty walk is not a value, and a starting point that reaches no row still ends at NoRowReachesTheStartingPoint naming the direction and the start; neither arm of Terminus carries free text, so 직무에 중요 has no field to arrive in. Hiding a score and resetting a weighting are append-only: both take &self and return a new view, nothing in the crate takes &mut self, and the prior number and the prior weighting travel into the new view's history, which is P2-Y2's fork-does-not-touch-its-base and P2-N2's assertion-is-not-changed-in-place one stage over. And the non-guarantee notice has one producer and no argument, every serialized view carries it, and published_notice refuses a document that lost it or altered it. Its dependency set is minimal and the edges it does not have are the point: no academic-store, so nothing here reaches the canonical writer and no migration is added; no academic-worker and no academic-egress-boundary, so nothing in its closure can launch a process or stage a payload; and no academic-export in the product closure, so the notice a recipient reads is the one the document carries.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, opens no file, reads no clock, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It spells no std::fs name at all: every matrix, placement, weight, band and competency arrives as an argument. the_readiness_crate_touches_no_file_and_no_socket in crates/readiness/tests/readiness_scans.rs compares the whole set of its use items against a 39-entry inventory split into non-crate imports, crate:: imports, pub use re-exports and three remaining items, the whole set of the two-segment paths it reaches through a crate root -- two, academic_domain::predicates and thiserror::Error -- and the whole set of the macros it invokes -- three, format, matches and vec -- against pinned inventories in both directions, and runs a whole-identifier pass for seventeen filesystem, clock, process and transport constructs over every file of the package, tests included, with Instant, SystemTime and a bare now among them. every_field_of_this_crate_is_in_the_inventory compares all 69 declared fields against a pinned inventory in both directions, requires each to say which of seven things it holds, and refuses a u8, a u64, an f32 or an f64 in any declared type, so neither a byte buffer nor a clock reading nor a ratio has a name to arrive under; the_unnamed_fields_are_pinned closes the two tuple structs and the five enumerations with unnamed variants that a named-field comparison would miss. Its link closure holds nothing that can open a socket beyond libc, which reaches it through academic-policy's bundled SQLite by way of academic-repository in P2-Y1's product closure. Every matrix, placement, score, walk and bundle in its test tree is synthetic and built in process; the only file the test tree writes is the P2-P1 bundle non_guarantee_disclaimer_survives_export publishes under the build lane's temporary directory and removes when it ends. No network call is made and no feed is read, because there is none.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-readiness links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. trybuild is a dev dependency already admitted for academic-scenario, academic-desktop, academic-proposal, academic-repository-classification, academic-repository-competency, academic-competency and academic-role-profile; serde_json is a dev dependency already admitted for academic-competency and academic-role-profile; and uuid is a dev dependency already admitted for academic-knowledge-state and academic-competency. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
